name: Maria Dorothea Stockburger — a son Andreas Mayer baptised at Sankt Georgen in September 1812
researcher_question: What children did Maria Dorothea Stockburger, wife of Johann Georg Meyer and mother of Magdalena (born 5 March 1817) and Anna Maria (born 9 November 1821), both baptised at Sankt Georgen im Schwarzwald, Baden, have besides these two?
notes: Record-hint fixture (filtered-list-samples-4.csv row 1, hint-samples.csv row 49, flag adds_son, confidence 3). Resolved as a false match: the 1812 baptism entry (ark:/61903/1:1:NNXZ-4L3) names a Johann Georg Mayer of the hamlet Rennuß as father, with all godparents also from Rennuß, whereas the tree couple's known children (Magdalena 1817, Anna Maria 1821) are from Oberkirnach — a different hamlet in the same parish. Verdict confirmed by reading the register image (Image 120 of group 3015626, image ark ark:/61903/3:1:3Q9M-CS43-L99T-Q).
